mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods with three consecutive months of declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% signals labor market weakness that typically precedes Fed rate cuts, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as markets anticipate policy stimulus.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods with UNRATE > 7.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate economic contraction that triggers policy stimulus, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as investors price in recovery.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods with concurrent GDPC1 and HOUST declines for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals manufacturing weakness that prompts Fed intervention, causing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days as markets anticipate policy support.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods with INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising retail sales (RSAFS) over three months indicates strong consumer demand that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods with three consecutive months of rising RSAFS, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days as markets price in higher rates.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in >55% of periods with CPIAUCSL > 2.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous FEDFUNDS increases and CPIAUCSL declines signal a 'soft landing' scenario where the Fed tightens without recession, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days as markets price in stable growth.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods with FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL falling for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong job growth (PAYEMS > 200k monthly) supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days, but this effect weakens during labor market slowdowns.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of periods with PAYEMS > 200k, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
